pages.text: $(o)The lectern has awakened.$(br)A voice that belongs to no one murmurs between the spines of the libraries.$(br2)The Almanac is not alone: the Order never wrote with a single hand.

$(o)"Two are the lecterns, one you already fill.$(br)The other waits for the keeper of creatures,$(br)the book that opens not with light but with fear."$(br2)Perhaps the other side of the altar knows what it lacks.
